lines.zh: 我沿着前哨站的木桩绕圈游。
lines.en: I circle the pillager outpost's wooden palisade.

lines.zh: 海底神殿的暗水是我的巡逻路。
lines.en: The monument's dim water is my patrol road.

lines.zh: 袭击鼓声一响，我鳃边的刺就竖起。
lines.en: When the raid horn sounds, the spines by my gills rise.

lines.zh: 我贴着海晶灯游，鳞片反出青光。
lines.en: I swim past sea lanterns, scales throwing green light.

lines.zh: 沙粒从我腹下滚过，像细小的鼓点。
lines.en: Sand rolls beneath my belly like tiny drumbeats.

lines.zh: 我侧身穿过沉船裂缝，刺没蹭到木板。
lines.en: I slip through a shipwreck gap without scraping a spine.

lines.zh: 暖海的水流推我，我顺势滑了三格。
lines.en: Warm currents push me, and I glide three blocks.

lines.zh: 我在袭击者的木筏边打转，等人落水。
lines.en: I circle the raiders' raft, waiting for someone to fall in.

lines.zh: 深水压着我的鳃盖，我照旧前行。
lines.en: Deep water presses my gill covers; I keep going.

lines.zh: 我用尾鳍拨开海草，露出一条窄道。
lines.en: My tail fin parts the kelp and opens a narrow lane.

lines.zh: 前哨栅栏的影子在水底摇，我从中穿过。
lines.en: The outpost fence's shadow sways on the seabed as I pass.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，让鳃刺始终朝着暗处。
lines.en: I swim slowly, keeping my gill spines toward the dark.

lines.zh: 一群守卫者经过，我压低身子让开路。
lines.en: A group of guardians passes, and I lower myself to yield.

lines.zh: 月光照进浅水，我的青玉鳞亮了一线。
lines.en: Moonlight enters the shallows and lights a line of jade scales.

lines.zh: 我顺着前哨的木梯影子上浮。
lines.en: I rise along the shadow of the outpost's ladder.

lines.zh: 碧空变种今天游得比我高。
lines.en: The azure variant swims higher than me today.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，让鳃慢慢开合。
lines.en: I hang in the water, gills opening and closing slowly.

lines.zh: 咸味从鳃里过一遍，我就知道潮向。
lines.en: One pass of salt tells me which way the current runs.

lines.zh: 我数着神殿里海晶灯的光点发呆。
lines.en: I count the lantern lights in the monument and drift.

lines.zh: 鳃刺偶尔抖一下，赶走太近的小鱼。
lines.en: A gill spine twitches now and then to shoo small fish.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，让水流替我撑住。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let the water hold me up.

lines.zh: 袭击还没开始时，我只是块会呼吸的石头。
lines.en: Before the raid starts, I am only a breathing stone.

lines.zh: 我想起黄沙变种晒过的暖海水。
lines.en: I recall the sun-warmed water my sandy kin swam in.

lines.zh: 我的鳃盖一张一合，像在数心跳。
lines.en: My gill covers open and close as if counting my pulse.

lines.zh: 水底的沙纹年年一样，我看得发困。
lines.en: The seabed ripples never change, and they make me drowsy.

lines.zh: 有只海龟路过，我让开半格水。
lines.en: A turtle passes, and I yield half a block of water.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串泡，看它们撞上栅栏。
lines.en: I release a string of bubbles and watch them hit the fence.

lines.zh: 甜蜜变种说夜里水更暖，我信一半。
lines.en: My sweet kin say night water is warmer; I half believe it.

lines.zh: 我把鳃刺收拢，省点力气等猎物。
lines.en: I fold my gill spines in, saving strength for prey.

lines.zh: 沉船里没有声音，只有我摆尾的轻响。
lines.en: The wreck is silent but for the soft beat of my tail.

lines.zh: 鳃边的刺挂着一点海藻。
lines.en: A bit of kelp hangs on my gill spines.

lines.zh: 我等袭击的号角，等得发闷。
lines.en: I wait for the raid horn until it goes stale.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我从水里仰头看你。
lines.en: You stand ashore, and I look up at you from the water.

lines.zh: 你的靴子还在滴水，我认得出那声音。
lines.en: Your boots still drip, and I know that sound.

lines.zh: 我鳃边的刺转向你，别当成欢迎。
lines.en: My gill spines turn toward you; do not take it as welcome.

lines.zh: 你没穿潜水装备，我替你算了算气。
lines.en: You wear no diving gear, so I do the breathing math.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼竿让我想起被钓走的同类。
lines.en: Your rod recalls kin I watched get hauled away.

lines.zh: 我停在两格外的水面，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I stop two blocks away and show only my eyes.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块沙是我刚巡过的。
lines.en: The sand under your feet is the patch I just patrolled.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，想知道你带了什么饵。
lines.en: I circle behind you, curious what bait you carry.

lines.zh: 你的火把光在水里碎成片，我盯着看。
lines.en: Your torchlight breaks into pieces underwater, and I stare.

lines.zh: 我不是瞪你，我在判断你算不算亡灵。
lines.en: I am not glaring; I am judging whether you count as undead.

lines.zh: 你的剑划开我的鳃盖，水立刻变红。
lines.en: Your blade opens my gill cover, and the water reddens.

lines.zh: 我被砍得翻了个身，尾巴还在摆。
lines.en: The cut flips me over, yet my tail still beats.

lines.zh: 刺断了半根，剩下的照样朝外。
lines.en: Half a spine snaps off, and the rest still point out.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起神殿里的守卫者。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the monument's guardians.

lines.zh: 我沉下半格，让沙盖住伤口。
lines.en: I sink half a block and let sand cover the wound.

lines.zh: 你的武器带走我一片青玉色的鳞。
lines.en: Your weapon carries off one of my jade-colored scales.

lines.zh: 疼让我钻进栅栏缝，那里你伸不进手。
lines.en: Pain drives me into the fence gap where your hand cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串短促的气泡，那是我的叫。
lines.en: I let out a short burst of bubbles; that is my cry.

lines.zh: 血在水里散得很快，我得更快。
lines.en: Blood spreads fast in the water, so I must be faster.

lines.zh: 你若再砍一次，我就沉进神殿阴影。
lines.en: Strike once more, and I sink into the monument's shadow.

lines.zh: 你手里那块腐肉，我闻着像敌人。
lines.en: That rotten flesh in your hand smells like an enemy.

lines.zh: 生鱼的味道让我鳃刺放松了一点。
lines.en: The smell of raw fish loosens my gill spines a little.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高，我的尾鳍自己动了。
lines.en: You lift the fish, and my tail moves on its own.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手上的，我只吃水里游的。
lines.en: I do not eat from hands; I eat what swims.

lines.zh: 那股腥味顺水过来，我跟了两格。
lines.en: That fishy scent rides the current, and I follow two blocks.

lines.zh: 若这是饵，你的钩子藏在哪里？
lines.en: If this is bait, where are you hiding the hook?

lines.zh: 我靠近又退开，刺始终没放下。
lines.en: I come close and pull back, spines never lowered.

lines.zh: 你的手心是热的，水里的食物不会热。
lines.en: Your palm is warm; food in the water is never warm.

lines.zh: 我闻出那是别的鱼，不是我的同类。
lines.en: I can tell that is another fish, not my own kind.

lines.zh: 诱惑这东西，深水里很少有人送来。
lines.en: Temptation is rarely delivered this deep.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的鳃刺，先疼的会是你。
lines.en: You bumped my gill spines, so the pain starts with you.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去硬，别拿膝盖试。
lines.en: My body is harder than it looks; do not test it with a knee.

lines.zh: 我被你顶偏半格，又游回原位。
lines.en: You shove me half a block off, and I drift back.

lines.zh: 水里没有让路，只有谁先转身。
lines.en: Water has no right of way, only who turns first.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踢到我的侧鳍，我甩尾回应。
lines.en: Your boot hits my side fin, and my tail answers.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过，鳞片刮到你的护腿。
lines.en: I slide past and my scales scrape your leggings.

lines.zh: 前哨站的水道太窄，我们只能互相挤。
lines.en: The outpost channel is narrow, so we can only squeeze past.

lines.zh: 你退开带起的水流把我推了个转。
lines.en: The current of your retreat spins me around.

lines.zh: 我撞你不是挑衅，是没算好距离。
lines.en: Bumping you is not a challenge; I misjudged the distance.

lines.zh: 神殿柱子旁，我们谁都不肯先让。
lines.en: By the monument pillar, neither of us yields first.

lines.zh: 同色的鳞在暗水里最好认。
lines.en: Same-colored scales are easiest to find in dark water.

lines.zh: 我用尾鳍扫沙，圈出一块干净水底。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the sand into a small clean patch.

lines.zh: 她的鳃刺比我短，我绕着多看了一眼。
lines.en: Her gill spines are shorter than mine, so I circle once more.

lines.zh: 我们把头对头，水从两边穿过鳃。
lines.en: We face each other while water passes through both our gills.

lines.zh: 袭击季配对，孩子生下来就会躲箭。
lines.en: We pair in raid season, and our young hide from arrows at birth.

lines.zh: 青玉和碧空配在一起，鳞色会杂。
lines.en: Jade and sky pair up, and the fry come out mixed.

lines.zh: 我咬住她尾边一片海草，算是应下。
lines.en: I take a bit of kelp by her tail as my yes.

lines.zh: 我们不唱歌，只让鳃盖同时开合。
lines.en: We do not sing; we only open our gill covers in time.

lines.zh: 她在神殿拱门下等我，那里水最缓。
lines.en: She waits under the monument arch, where the water is calmest.

lines.zh: 沙坑挖好了，剩下的交给潮水。
lines.en: The sand nest is dug, and the tide does the rest.

lines.zh: 你把掉在水里的生鱼捡起来，我盯着。
lines.en: You pick up the dropped raw fish, and I watch.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片不捡东西，鳍也握不住。
lines.en: My scales pick nothing up, and fins cannot grip.

lines.zh: 你若把鱼扔回水里，也许我会靠近。
lines.en: Throw the fish back, and I might come closer.

lines.zh: 那是我同类的肉，你却当成战利品。
lines.en: That is my kin's flesh, and you call it loot.

lines.zh: 沉船箱子开了，我游过去看了一眼。
lines.en: The wreck chest opens, and I swim over for a look.

lines.zh: 我把嘴边的沙粒吐掉，那不算拾取。
lines.en: I spit out a grain of sand, which hardly counts as picking up.

lines.zh: 前哨站掉落的铁锭沉底，与我无关。
lines.en: Dropped iron from the outpost sinks, and it is nothing to me.

lines.zh: 你要真想要我的鱼，就从鳃边拿。
lines.en: If you truly want my fish, take it past my gills.

lines.zh: 我只衔游动的猎物，不衔物品。
lines.en: I only seize swimming prey, never loose items.

lines.zh: 水底的线头缠上我的刺，我甩了两下。
lines.en: A thread snags my spine, and I flick it twice.

lines.zh: 那具骷髅走下水，我的鳃刺全张开了。
lines.en: That skeleton steps into the water, and all my gill spines flare.

lines.zh: 溺尸的手臂伸过来，我先咬它的腕。
lines.en: The drowned reaches out, and I bite its wrist first.

lines.zh: 亡灵的气味像铁锈，我不会认错。
lines.en: Undead smell of rust, and I never get that wrong.

lines.zh: 守卫者的光扫过来，我记下它的位置。
lines.en: A guardian's beam sweeps past, and I mark where it stands.

lines.zh: 袭击者在水边张望，我沉到影子里。
lines.en: A raider peers at the water, and I sink into shadow.

lines.zh: 你身上若有亡灵味，我也会转向你。
lines.en: If you carry undead scent, I will turn on you too.

lines.zh: 猎物一进神殿范围，我的尾就不摆了。
lines.en: Once prey enters the monument, my tail stops swaying.

lines.zh: 那条河豚先鼓起来，我便改了主意。
lines.en: The pufferfish inflates first, so I change my mind.

lines.zh: 我看它从栅栏缺口游过，追了上去。
lines.en: I see it pass the fence gap and give chase.

lines.zh: 目标选定后，我只剩一个方向。
lines.en: Once I choose a target, I have only one direction left.

lines.zh: 我贴着它的影子游，等它换气。
lines.en: I hug its shadow, waiting for it to take a breath.

lines.zh: 它每划一次水，我就近半格。
lines.en: Every stroke it takes, I close half a block.

lines.zh: 我的鳃刺张到最开，那是开战的样子。
lines.en: My gill spines spread widest; that is my war face.

lines.zh: 我绕到它侧后，避开正面的武器。
lines.en: I swing behind its flank, clear of its weapon.

lines.zh: 水底没有掩体，我只好贴着海草走。
lines.en: The seabed offers no cover, so I keep to the kelp.

lines.zh: 它在岸上，我在水里，我等它下来。
lines.en: It stays ashore and I stay in water, waiting for it.

lines.zh: 我不急，深水会替我耗掉它的气。
lines.en: I am patient; the deep water will spend its breath.

lines.zh: 它转身时水纹乱了，我趁机逼近。
lines.en: Its turn muddies the current, and I close in.

lines.zh: 我把刺对着它的颈，尾鳍稳住身体。
lines.en: I aim my spines at its neck and steady myself with my tail.

lines.zh: 它若逃向浅滩，我便放弃这次追击。
lines.en: If it flees to the shallows, I abandon this chase.

lines.zh: 我用鳃刺划开它的手臂，水立刻浑了。
lines.en: My gill spines rake its arm, and the water clouds at once.

lines.zh: 一口咬住它的脚踝，牙齿往里拧。
lines.en: I bite its ankle and twist my teeth inward.

lines.zh: 它反击撞上神殿石壁，我只退一格。
lines.en: Its counter slams the monument wall, and I retreat one block.

lines.zh: 我把它往深水拖，那里它挣不动。
lines.en: I drag it into deeper water, where it cannot struggle.

lines.zh: 珊瑚划破我的侧鳍，我照样冲。
lines.en: Coral cuts my side fin, and I charge anyway.

lines.zh: 我的刺扎进腐肉，拔出时带出黑水。
lines.en: My spines pierce rotten flesh and pull out black water.

lines.zh: 它挥剑砍空，我贴着剑锋滑到背后。
lines.en: Its sword cuts air, and I slide past the blade.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我得先换口气。
lines.en: After this blow, I must take a breath first.

lines.zh: 我把它的头按进沙里，再用尾压住。
lines.en: I press its head into the sand and hold it with my tail.

lines.zh: 它散架时骨片沉底，我绕了两圈。
lines.en: When it comes apart, the bones sink, and I circle twice.

lines.zh: 我在前哨站水道里睁眼，栅栏就在头顶。
lines.en: I wake in the outpost channel with the fence overhead.

lines.zh: 神殿的冷光落在我背上，我摆尾试水。
lines.en: The monument's cold light lands on my back, and I test the water.

lines.zh: 袭击的号角响起时，我从暗处游出。
lines.en: When the raid horn sounds, I swim out of the dark.

lines.zh: 碧空变种要先看见天，才肯落进水里。
lines.en: The sky variant needs a sight of sky before entering water.

lines.zh: 沙漠边的暖海把我孵出来，沙是烫的。
lines.en: The warm sea by the desert hatched me, and the sand was hot.

lines.zh: 甜蜜变种只在夜里现身，月是唯一的光。
lines.en: The sweet variant only shows at night, the moon its only light.

lines.zh: 我是那十分之一的黄沙，鳞上带沙粒。
lines.en: I am the one-in-ten sandy, sand still on my scales.

lines.zh: 海底神殿的守卫没赶我，我便留下。
lines.en: The monument's guardians did not drive me off, so I stayed.

lines.zh: 朗姆色的鳞在浅水里像一块旧木头。
lines.en: Rum-colored scales look like old wood in the shallows.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推进栅栏缺口，我就在这里了。
lines.en: The tide pushed me through the fence gap, and here I am.

lines.zh: 水是凉的，火却烧到了我的鳃上。
lines.en: The water is cool, yet fire still burns my gills.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔回礁石，掉了两片鳞。
lines.en: I fall from the surface onto rock and lose two scales.

lines.zh: 我这鳃只适合咬人。
lines.en: These gills of mine are built for biting.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀出水面，鳃里全是沙。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear of the water, sand in my gills.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水面，扎进我的侧鳍。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the water and lodges in my side fin.

lines.zh: 那道紫光让我的鳃刺抖个不停。
lines.en: That violet light makes my gill spines shiver without pause.

lines.zh: 水底没有猎物，我的腹侧凹下去。
lines.en: No prey on the seabed, and my flank has gone hollow.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我的鳞片全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea, and every scale goes numb.

lines.zh: 水没了，我掉进没有底的暗处。
lines.en: The water is gone, and I fall into floorless darkness.
